items.lede: The space agency solicited ideas for reboosting Hubble four years ago, but they didn't go anywhere.
items.title: Once again, NASA is asking for ideas to rescue Hubble from certain death

items.lede: Gravity is a cruel mistress, slowly dragging the famed telescope ever closer to its ultimate demise with every day. Hubble is in no immediate danger of burning up in the Earth's atmosphere, but its time will run out in the early to mid 2030s unless its orbit is boosted. So NASA is taking proposals from […]
items.title: NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble
